frozen_meaning: At least two eligible ways out. The table separately requires one normal 1-UP exit and one accessory exit.
One normal 1-UP way out and one accessory way out; clear width is assessed under the door clause.
Maximum travel is 50 m with two available exits, or 30 m with one. These plans have one relevant origin and all eligible exits are accessible from it.
Walk from the public-room door to the dead-end junction at most 10 m.
The horizontal connector between a stair and exit must offer at least two passage units, 1.40 m.
Protected stair leads directly outdoors or discharges at most 20 m from an exit.
Clear passage for the designated one-UP door must be at least 0.855 m after the permitted 5% below 0.90 m.
Subdivision doors in the horizontal circulation used in both directions toward exits must swing both ways.
No isolated group of one or two steps in the principal circulation.
Horizontal circulation enclosure fire rating meets the rating required for the structure.
Horizontal circulation provides prescribed smoke protection under the general provision.
Door glazing is transparent and is neither red nor orange.
A nonmotorized sliding door cannot close a public evacuation exit.
Horizontal circulation ceiling finish meets M1.
Circulation partition and floor finish meet M2 and M4 respectively.
With the public present, the exit opens from inside by pushing or by easy use of one device per leaf.
Outdoor circulation surface must be firm, smooth and unobstructed for wheels and canes.
Each substantial change in level needs an inclined path.
Sidewalk width must be within the inclusive 1.50 m to 2.00 m range.
The perpendicular curb-cut incline and both side transitions must each be below 5%.
At least one in twenty stalls in public car parks or open-to-public garages must be reserved.
The listed building classes must be adapted and have a usable accessible approach route.
When customers use counters, shelves or writing surfaces, one in ten of the relevant equipment must be adapted.
One in twenty seats in public rooms must be adapted.
In the specified public buildings, adapt one in ten of the equipment in rooms and sanitary facilities.
Public circulation spaces must be served by lifts that conform to the referenced standards.
Public circulation passages must be at least 2 m wide and no steeper than 12%; both conditions apply.
Each change of direction needs a resting landing of at least 1 m².
The relevant passages require handrails on both sides.
The principal entrance must be at least 1 m wide with lateral slope no more than 20%.
Provide a fixed telephone for people with visual or hearing impairments at the rate of one per entrance.
